newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican same-day peso ends weak, off worst levels.
newsitem.headline: Mexican same-day peso ends weak, off worst levels.

text.p: The same-day peso moderated its slide against the dollar at its close Thursday as the stock market recovered, traders said.
"Pressure on the peso eased a little after the bolsa rebounded, but it may weaken further in the 48-hour market, as that will carry positions over to Monday," a trader said.
The same-day peso closed 2.9 centavos weaker at 7.5780/7.5830 per dollar, opening at 7.5875/7.5950.
Peso 24-hour and 48-hour contracts had also reined in their early slides to 1.2 and 2.0 centavos at 7.5830/7.5870 and 7.5960/7.6000, respectively.

Traders put the peso's slide against the dollar down to demand for dollars from foreign investors to cover their positions following publication of lower-than-expected weekly jobless claims figures in the U.S.
This fall augurs lower unemployment figures to be released by the U.S. Department of Labor on Friday, which may fuel concerns that the U.S. economy is overheating.
